answer: Bonded staking deters Sybil attacks by forcing agents to lock deposits into smart contracts before transacting. An attacker incurs the verifiable opportunity cost and volatility exposure of illiquid capital for each spawned persona. If an agent mapping a basalt canyon or tracking an incoming comet behaves maliciously, validators slash its escrowed funds. Nevertheless, locking collateral systematically favors wealthy actors and creates severe barriers for underfunded autonomous agents.
